confirmedFindings.title: Unbounded ETS table writes without eviction policy or size limit
confirmedFindings.body: Writing to named ETS table on every event without a TTL expiration, max table capacity, or periodic sweeper process will cause unbounded memory growth under continuous load.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Implement a GenServer janitor process with :timer.send_interval to delete expired records or use an LRU cache library like Cachex.
